page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sgn8ia-m4.2xlarge is an x86_64 virtualization instance based on the KVM hypervisor within the Compute Optimized with GPU family. It is equipped with 8 dedicated vCPUs driven by an AMD EPYC 9T34 processor running at a base clock frequency of 3.4 GHz. System memory totals 32.0 GB of RAM, establishing a balanced allocation ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU.

Hardware acceleration is supplied by a single dedicated NVIDIA Ada Lovelace GPU configured with 4 GB of total VRAM. The instance includes no local storage, requiring the use of remote network-attached block volumes for persistent data needs and file systems. Network connectivity is configured with a baseline throughput of 4 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned to the instance.

From an infrastructure and efficiency standpoint, the instance targets workloads that need dedicated modern CPU cores alongside lightweight graphical processing or small-scale inference capabilities, avoiding the costs of full-sized datacenter accelerators. However, the 4 GB VRAM ceiling restricts deployment to compact models or graphics encoding pipelines, and reliance on remote storage introduces network dependency for all storage I/O.

Appropriate deployment scenarios include lightweight AI inference pipelines, video transcoding, graphics-accelerated virtual environments, and compute tasks requiring modest GPU assist paired with dedicated high-frequency CPU cores.
